topic: Photoroom launches Video Ad Maker: turns existing product photos into 5-10 s video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube (The Interline, 4 Nov 2026)
instagram_caption:
Your product photos can now become video ads.

On 4 November, Photoroom launched Video Ad Maker. It turns existing product photos, or a product link, into 5 to 10 second video ads: vertical for Meta and TikTok, landscape for YouTube and websites. You review the creative direction, script and video plan before anything is generated, and it can add voice-over, music and optional AI actors. It sits on Photoroom's Max and Ultra plans.

Why it matters: Meta says video is over 60% of time spent on Facebook and Instagram, yet most small D2C teams make only a few videos a season. When a video takes minutes instead of a shoot day, the constraint moves to your brief: what to say, to whom, and what you'll test.

What to do this week:
1. Pick your top 10 SKUs and write a one-line brief for each: the buyer, the problem, the proof.
2. Make 3 video variants per SKU and test them against your best static ad before the wedding-season push.
3. Set rules for AI actors and voice-overs, and label AI-made content where platforms ask.

Cheap video doesn't make good video. Clear thinking does.
